clauses.scope_note: Applies to access to and use of the Helix Platform under this Agreement, subject to the applicable Order Form and Documentation.
clauses.condition_explanation: When accessing or using the Platform, Customer and Users must use it only for purposes that are legal, proper, and in accordance with the Agreement, applicable Order Form, and applicable laws or regulations.

clauses.actor_role: Customer and its Users; they must not encourage third parties to engage in the listed conduct
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits modifying, adapting, altering, translating, or creating derivative works of the Helix Platform; transferring it to third parties other than Users; removing or obscuring proprietary-rights notices; using it to create a competing product or service; removing or modifying Helix or supplier notices; and using it outside the applicable Documentation or for unlawful purposes. The reverse-engineering restriction specifically concerns Helix Hub and has an exception to the extent applicable law permits the activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: These are direct restrictions on Customer and Users. The reverse-engineering restriction does not apply to the extent applicable law permits the activity.

clauses.scope_note: Helix Platform should not be used as the basis to deploy systems that must be hardened or highly secure, involve mission-critical operations, or operate in the listed safety-critical settings (including nuclear facilities, aircraft navigation, medical devices, and real-time control systems), or where service errors could cause death, injury, or physical or environmental damage. The text says “should not,” rather than stating an unqualified prohibition.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies when the Platform is used as the basis for deployment in one of the specified high-security, mission-critical, or potentially harmful situations.

clauses.scope_note: At the Personal Offering level only, Helix Runner use is limited to the listed use categories. Personal Use includes developing free or paid applications; Educational Use is classroom academic or research use or contribution to an open-source project; Small Business Environment requires both fewer than 250 employees and less than US $10,000,000 annual revenue. Government Entities are prohibited from Personal Offering use except for Educational Use. Helix has sole discretion to determine whether an entity is a Government Entity.
clauses.condition_explanation: At least one listed use category must apply. The small-business category requires both stated size and revenue thresholds. For a Government Entity, only Educational Use is an available category under this clause.

clauses.actor_role: Customer and its Users; they must not allow third parties to engage in the listed conduct
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits the listed activities in connection with the Helix Platform, including distributing specified objectionable, destructive, deceptive, infringing, or unlawful content; specified misuse of personal or confidential information; downloading content known or reasonably believed to be unlawfully distributable; interference with users; unauthorized commercial exploitation (including mirroring or replicating content for a commercial service); modifying, adapting, translating, or reverse engineering any portion unless Helix authorizes it; removing rights notices; framing or reformatting administration pages; unlawful peer-to-peer sharing; specified automated retrieval or indexing for unauthorized purposes; fraudulent account creation; and using the Platform or its interfaces to access a Helix service in violation of the Agreement. This clause does not establish a general restriction on activities unrelated to the Platform.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibitions apply to the specific listed conduct. Modification, adaptation, translation, and reverse engineering are prohibited unless authorized by Helix; the commercial-purpose restriction concerns unauthorized commercial purposes.

clauses.scope_note: Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and grants Helix a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to reproduce, distribute, and otherwise use and display that data solely as necessary to provide the Helix Platform, including updates and upgrades. Customer remains responsible for the listed qualities and legality of its data. Personal information is subject to the Data Processing Agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: Helix’s licensed uses of Customer Data are limited to what may be necessary to provide the Platform, including its updates and upgrades. The referenced Data Processing Agreement is not included in the supplied text.

clauses.scope_note: Customer must maintain complete and accurate records concerning Customer’s and Users’ use of the Platform and other information reasonably necessary to verify compliance with the Agreement and applicable Order Form. Helix or its representative may inspect the records on at least ten days’ prior notice. If records show excess permitted use and underpayment, Helix may invoice for past or ongoing underpaid amounts, which Customer must promptly pay upon receipt. Audit results may be shared with certain third-party licensors when Helix is obligated to do so, and audit rights may be assigned to those licensors.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recordkeeping obligation applies while the Platform is used. The inspection right requires at least ten days’ prior notice. The payment obligation is triggered by an invoice for underpaid amounts resulting from excess use.

clauses.scope_note: The Agreement or an Order Form may be terminated by either party for the other party’s material breach not cured within 30 days after written notice. If no Order Forms are outstanding, either party may terminate the Agreement on at least 30 days’ prior written notice. Upon expiration or termination of the Agreement or applicable Order Form, the Platform license automatically terminates and Customer must discontinue all Platform use. The identified survival sections remain in effect as stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: Continued use is prohibited after the Agreement or applicable Order Form expires or terminates; for breach termination, the stated cure period is 30 days after written notice.

clauses.scope_note: On submission of Feedback, Customer grants Helix a royalty-free, fully paid, sublicensable, transferable, non-exclusive, irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide license to make, use, sell, offer for sale, import, and otherwise exploit the Feedback without restriction, including by incorporating it into Helix products and services. Feedback expressly excludes Customer Confidential Information and Customer Data.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grant arises upon submission of Feedback, but does not cover Customer Confidential Information or Customer Data.
